blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. A sightseeing tour of Santiago with an English-speaking guide: La Moneda Palace and Plaza de Armas, the Governors’ House, City Hall, the Main Post Office, the Royal Audiencia and the Cathedral. Ascend Santa Lucía Hill, then explore the modern districts of Vitacura, Las Condes and Providencia, driving along the Mapocho River and the main avenues.

An optional visit to the wineries of the Maipo Valley with a tasting is available at an additional $230 per person, minimum 2 participants.
